purpose: Test whether the frozen WM-v2B future-proprio head faithfully represents relative A0/A1/A2 physical counterfactual differences before any WM-v2C design.

coordinate_contract.validation_residual_recovery: The frozen validation sidecar stores elementwise SmoothL1(beta=1). Recover |residual| exactly as sqrt(2*loss) when loss<0.5, otherwise loss+0.5. This is sufficient for RMSE, MAE, SmoothL1, horizon, group, and task summaries; signs are not inferred.
coordinate_contract.branch_prediction: The matched sidecar stores predicted and real absolute future proprio in the same frozen standardized coordinate system.

metric_contract.direction: cosine(delta_pred, delta_real) over eligible standardized proprio vectors
metric_contract.magnitude: L2 norms plus ratio-of-means and the distribution of per-point pred_norm/real_norm
metric_contract.relative_improvement: (aggregate zero-difference RMSE - aggregate differential RMSE) / aggregate zero-difference RMSE
metric_contract.ranking: Within each branch-point/horizon context, rank the three candidate-pair L2 separations; report mean within-context Spearman, three pair-of-pair ordering accuracy with ties worth 0.5, and pooled Pearson/Spearman.
metric_contract.sign: sign agreement per dimension only where abs(delta_real[d]) reaches the frozen threshold
metric_contract.coupling: Pearson and Spearman for real physical L2 versus real visual cosine separation and predicted physical L2 versus WM-v2B predicted visual cosine separation

bootstrap.unit: matched branch point; resampling retains all three candidate pairs, all eight horizons, and all 12 dimensions

authorization_gate.differential_improvement: aggregate relative improvement >= 0.05 and its branch-block bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
authorization_gate.direction_alignment: aggregate mean cosine direction >= 0.10 and its branch-block bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
authorization_gate.ranking_relation: mean within-context Spearman >= 0.10 with bootstrap CI lower bound > 0, and pairwise ranking accuracy >= 0.55 with bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.50
authorization_gate.no_candidate_specific_collapse: for every A0-A1/A0-A2/A1-A2 pair: differential relative improvement > 0, mean direction > 0, and predicted/real norm ratio-of-means >= 0.05
authorization_gate.go: all four gate groups pass -> GO_WM_V2C_DESIGN

mechanism_labels.absolute_distribution_shift: branch pooled RMSE or MAE divided by validation counterpart >= 1.5
mechanism_labels.relative_signal_valid: GO gate passes while absolute_distribution_shift is true -> PHYSICAL_MEDIATOR_RELATIVE_SIGNAL_VALID
mechanism_labels.visual_transfer_block_confirmed: GO gate passes and frozen VISUAL_TRANSFER_FAILURE_CONFIRMED is present -> PHYSICAL_MEDIATOR_VALID_VISUAL_TRANSFER_BLOCK_CONFIRMED
mechanism_labels.mixed: Both valid-relative labels may be reported when their conditions co-occur. Counterfactual fail is mutually exclusive with them.

forbidden: run or access any simulator episode
train or modify WM-v2B or any WM-v2C
modify C0-v2, candidate generation, production noise scale, or reranker
run C1, C2, D20-v2, or any init state
use task success, reward, done, or fake counterfactual targets
change gates after reading differential results
overwrite any frozen upstream result or sidecar
